app.name: go-on GUI
app.monitorOnlyBanner: Monitor-only mode · GUI will not auto-start backend

setup.title: Setup
setup.hint: Select a setup scenario to automatically configure the backend path and protocol mode.

config.title: Config
config.protocolModeFromConfigDesc: Use the protocol mode defined in the project configuration file.
config.monitorOnlyHint: If enabled, GUI will not auto-start the backend process.
config.summaryHint: Review each group below and change values as needed.

wizard.title: Configuration Wizard
wizard.subtitle: Step-by-step configuration of the backend path and protocol mode

step1.title: Enter executable path
step1.description: Specify the full path to the backend executable, e.g. go-on.exe or go-on binary.

step2.title: Select protocol mode
step2.description: Choose how the GUI communicates with the backend. The default 'from config file' works for most setups.

step3.title: Review and confirm
step3.description: Double-check the executable path and protocol mode before saving.

local.title: Local Development
local.description: Run the backend from a local directory. The GUI will try to auto-detect the executable.

shared.title: Shared/Target Directory
shared.description: The backend lives in a shared or build output directory. You'll specify the path manually.

editor.title: Editor Integration
editor.description: Connect the GUI to a backend managed by VS Code / Cursor / Windsurf.

adaptive.description: Auto-detect the preferred protocol from the endpoint's capabilities.

providers.title: Providers
providers.hint1: Select which provider and model to use for AI features.
providers.hint2: API keys are stored securely in the backend keystore, never send them to anywhere else.
providers.hint3: To use a custom provider, set the environment variable first, then click Refresh.
providers.envVarHint: Set this variable before starting the GUI
providers.apiKeyHint: Enter a new API key or leave blank to keep the current one

toast.recoverPrompt: The backend seems unresponsive. Would you like to restart?

common.name: Name
common.offlineModeHint: Backend is unreachable. Some features may be unavailable.
common.staleDataHint: Data may be out of date. Refresh for latest information.

onboarding.title: First-Run Guide
onboarding.subtitle: Connect the runtime, verify health, and move between monitor, config, and chat in one pass.

checklist.title: Before you continue
checklist.executable: Confirm the backend executable path or let GUI auto-detect it.
checklist.protocol: Check protocol mode in Config when you need to override project defaults.
checklist.health: Use Monitor to confirm the runtime is healthy before opening Chat.

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.body: Watch health, logs, AI usage, and integration status from one place.

config.title: Config
config.body: Set backend path, protocol mode, providers, and startup behavior.

chat.title: Chat
chat.body: Open conversation sessions against the local runtime once health is green.

welcome.title: Overview
welcome.tip: The GUI is organized into three tabs: monitor, config, and chat.

connect.title: Connect Runtime
connect.ready: The runtime is already running. You can move straight to config or chat.
connect.notReady: Start the runtime or configure the executable path before using chat features.

workflow.title: Daily Workflow
workflow.providersBody: Open Providers under Config to confirm model routing and API keys.
workflow.observeBody: Use Monitor to inspect endpoint health, recent logs, and integration state.
workflow.chatBody: Open Chat after the runtime is healthy and send real requests to the local endpoint.

finish.title: Ready to Work
finish.body: You can reopen this guide from the header at any time.
